column1: # The files of src/ that raise a corruption error (ERRCODE_INDEX_CORRUPTED, ERRCODE_DATA_CORRUPTED) with a message that names no index: a decoder is given bytes.
# FILE <TAB> the files that push the context scope (sift_errctx_push, core/errctx.h) its errors are raised under; scripts/check-errors.sh checks that each calls it
# and that no file with such a message is missing here. "-" is a gap: the entry points that read it push no scope yet.
# A file whose message does name the index (SIFT_CORRUPT, SIFT_SEG_CORRUPT) is not listed.
